value.rationale: The primary paper’s stated goal for the period-doubling case is asymptotic periodic complexity, but its general machinery stalls at the spectral boundary and leaves a fourfold gap between logarithmic coefficients. The result closes that central gap with the sharp coefficient 2/3 and a quantitative O(log log n) remainder. The seven-state scale law also explains structurally why the power-of-two coefficient extends to all n.
